katNote: I kept one big sight per day and left room for snacking - Chengdu is a city you taste, not a checklist you race. Book the panda base early, everything else is walk-in friendly.

climate.label: 10–18°C
climate.note: March in Chengdu: mild days, chilly nights, mostly cloudy with occasional light rain. Bring a light jacket - no umbrella needed most years.

hotel.name: Boutique hotel near Chunxi Road 春熙路
hotel.tip: Walkable to tonight food street, 2 metro stops from the panda bus hub.

days.title: Day 1 · Arrival + old town lanes
days.note: Landing day - keep it light, shake off the jetlag with tea and noodles.

stops.name: Kuanzhai Alleys 宽窄巷子
stops.desc: Qing-dynasty lanes restored into teahouses and snack streets. Touristy but genuinely pretty - go late afternoon when day-trippers leave.
stops.tips: Skip the restaurants inside the alley - overpriced. Buy a 糖油果子 (fried sugar rice balls, ¥10) from the street cart near the west exit instead.

stops.name: Shufeng Yayun Teahouse 蜀风雅韵
stops.desc: Classic Sichuan opera night: face-changing, hand shadows, tea served mid-show. The tourist-friendly intro to Sichuan culture.
stops.mustBookNote: Book tickets 3+ days ahead - front rows sell out
stops.tips: Sit rows 2–4: close enough for face-changing, far enough to see the whole stage. Arrive 30 min early for the free tea-pouring performance outside.

days.title: Day 2 · Pandas + Three Kingdoms
days.note: Early start for pandas (they nap after 11am), history in the afternoon.

stops.name: Chengdu Panda Base 大熊猫繁育研究基地
stops.desc: The world's best place to see giant pandas awake and eating. Morning feeding time is the whole show - go at opening.
stops.mustBookNote: Entry tickets release online and sell out on holidays
stops.tips: Take metro Line 3 to Panda Avenue, then the free shuttle. Head straight to Moonlight Nursery first - babies before the crowds arrive at 9:30.

stops.name: Wuhou Shrine 武侯祠
stops.desc: Three Kingdoms history in a cypress-shaded garden - the Zhuge Liang memorial. Quiet, atmospheric, easy 90 minutes.
stops.tips: Rent the audio guide (¥20, has English). The red-walled bamboo corridor on the east side is the photo everyone takes - go before 4pm when tour groups hit it.

stops.name: Jinli Old Street 锦里
stops.desc: Right next door to Wuhou Shrine - lantern-lined snack street. Dinner here is a snack crawl, not a sit-down meal.
stops.tips: Work the edges: 三大炮 sticky rice balls at the entrance, then walk to the back canal for quieter stalls. Skip anything that says '网红' - it's a tourist trap signal.

days.title: Day 3 · Local life + city lights
days.note: A slow day: morning tea with the locals, shopping, riverside night views.

stops.name: People's Park 人民公园
stops.desc: The real Chengdu: retirees dancing, mahjong clacking, and the famous Heming Teahouse pouring jasmine tea since 1923.
stops.tips: Sit outside at Heming, order a bottomless jasmine refill (¥25). Ear-cleaning masters wander with tuning forks - ¥40 for the experience if you're brave.

stops.name: Chen Mapo Tofu 陈麻婆豆腐
stops.desc: The original 1862 shop behind mapo tofu. Loud, fast, delicious - the definitive Sichuan lunch.
stops.tips: Order: mapo tofu (微辣 mild-spicy is still spicy here), 蒜泥白肉 cold pork in garlic sauce, rice. Point at neighbours' tables if the menu photo wall confuses you - staff are used to it.

stops.name: Taikoo Li & IFS 太古里
stops.desc: Heritage courtyard blocks rebuilt into open-air shopping. The climbing panda sculpture on IFS is Chengdu's selfie landmark.
stops.budget: Free to wander · brands are brands
stops.tips: Go up to the IFS 7th-floor garden for the panda's face - no queue like the ground-floor crowd. Fangsuo Bookstore inside the mall looks like a cave, worth 10 minutes.

stops.name: Anshun Bridge 安顺廊桥
stops.desc: Illuminated Ming-style bridge over the Jinjiang River - the postcard night view. Riverside bars underneath if the night is young.
stops.tips: Best photo is from the south bank, 100m east of the bridge. The restaurant ON the bridge is overpriced - eat elsewhere.

days.title: Day 4 · Last tastes + departure
days.note: Slow morning, one proper breakfast, then off to the airport.

stops.name: Jinjiang riverside walk 锦江
stops.desc: A gentle hour along the river where locals do morning tai chi. Feeling brave? Join the back-stretching group at the willow corner.
stops.tips: Bike-share (Meituan app, scan with Alipay/WeChat) works great along this stretch - ¥1.5 per ride, unlocks with the same apps you set up before flying.

stops.name: Chengdu Shuangliu Airport 双流机场 T1/T2
stops.desc: Metro Line 10 goes straight there from town (30 min). Leave the city centre 3 hours before your flight - security is thorough but fast.
stops.tips: Airport food is fine but flat - grab a last 蛋烘糕 egg pancake from a street stall near your hotel BEFORE the metro. They don't exist past security.
